name: Lime plaster pigmented with red ochre

diffuseAlbedo.source: Palette.json: white.lime-plaster workingsByEra.classical (pigmented with red ochre and burnished in the Classical Hall's niches); Story.md 2.2
diffuseAlbedo.note: Red ochre (an iron-oxide red, hematite) mixed into the setting coat: a first Pompeian red read from photographs of Pompeian walls, until a specimen is measured. The lime and its pores are the plaster's own.

refractiveIndex.derivation: n = (1 + sqrt(F0)) / (1 - sqrt(F0)) at the middle of the F0 range, 0.0495

wettingDepth.source: Substances/lime-plaster.json: stock.coats[2].thickness (2 to 3 mm, the setting coat)
wettingDepth.derivation: the middle of the setting coat's thickness: the body light and water reach in the finish

bed.note: The reach of one trowel pass, a first value until the trowel marks are measured.

bedAspect.source: Substances/lime-plaster.json: formation (a mixed aggregate with no bedding)

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012 (as for stone); no measurement of a plaster face was read

toneSpread.note: A set white varies little in tone; a first value.

roughnessSpread.note: A first value for the sheen's variation between trowel passes.
